A gnomish Healer in debug mode wishes for the Bell of Opening twice (the second wish reports 'already have silver bell?', and u.uhave.bell stays set), wishes for a wand of death and zaps it at herself, answers y to 'Die?', declines the disclosure prompts and answers y to 'Save bones?'. Freeing the first bell clears u.uhave.bell, so freeing the second reports 'don't have silver bell?'. Seed, date and inputs were chosen independently of every recorded session.
